24.0.en: Her left [[lung:lung]] sounds a bit low, and one small [[gland:gland]] feels bigger than before.
24.0.zh: 她左边的肺听起来有点发沉，一个小腺体摸起来也比从前大了。

24.1.en: The scan shows the [[chamber:chambers]] of her heart, and food now moves slowly through her long [[intestine:intestine]].
24.1.zh: 扫描照出了她心脏的各个腔室，食物在她长长的肠道里也走得慢了。

24.2.en: She rubs her thick [[thigh:thigh]] and bends each stiff [[joint:joint]] to show us where it aches.
24.2.zh: 她揉着粗粗的大腿，弯一弯每个发僵的关节，指给我们看哪里疼。

24.3.en: A warm [[blanket:blanket]] lies over her [[lap:lap]], covering her thick [[ankle:ankle]] and tired feet.
24.3.zh: 一条暖毯搭在她腿上，盖住她粗粗的脚踝和疲倦的双脚。

24.4.en: She lifts her aching [[heel:heel]] and wiggles each little [[toe:toe]] to make us laugh.
24.4.zh: 她抬起酸痛的脚后跟，动动每一根小脚趾，逗得大家直笑。

24.5.en: Every thin [[muscle:muscle]] needs daily walks, and every tiny [[pore:pore]] needs fresh air too.
24.5.zh: 每一块瘦削的肌肉都需要天天散步，每一个小毛孔也都需要新鲜空气。

25.0.en: The [[nurse:nurse]] feels her slow [[pulse:pulse]] and says every red [[artery:artery]] still carries blood well.
25.0.zh: 护士摸着她缓慢的脉搏，说每一条红红的动脉仍把血送得很好。

25.1.en: Every thin [[nerve:nerve]] sends quick signals, and every small [[hormone:hormone]] sways her moods.
25.1.zh: 每一根细细的神经都传递着飞快的信号，每一分小小的激素都牵动着她的情绪起伏。

25.2.en: Walking together in the morning is a [[gentle:gentle]] [[stimulus:stimulus]] that keeps the [[immune:immune]] [[guard:guard]] strong.
25.2.zh: 清晨一起散步是一种温和的刺激，能让身体的免疫防线保持强壮。

25.3.en: Her sleep [[biorhythm:biorhythm]] changed last [[spring:spring]], and her poor [[eyesight:eyesight]] makes reading hard.
25.3.zh: 去年春天她的睡眠节律变了，变差的视力也让她看书吃力。

25.4.en: The [[visual:visual]] chart is simple, and every letter stays clearly [[visible:visible]] from far away.
25.4.zh: 那张视力表很简单，每个字母从很远的地方都看得清清楚楚。

25.5.en: Her answers come out [[vague:vague]], not [[dumb:dumb]], for she feels shy before strangers.
25.5.zh: 她的回答有些含糊，却不是笨，只是在陌生人面前害羞。

26.0.en: The [[aural:aural]] [[test:test]] goes well, and a quick [[dental:dental]] check shows clean teeth too.
26.0.zh: 听觉测试很顺利，快速的牙科检查也显示牙齿很干净。

26.1.en: She stays [[awake:awake]] till ten, and never tries to hide a big [[yawn:yawn]] late at [[night:night]].
26.1.zh: 她到十点还醒着，深夜里也从不掩饰大大的哈欠。

26.2.en: A short [[nap:nap]] at noon helps her rest, but she never likes to [[doze:doze]] off after dinner.
26.2.zh: 中午小睡片刻能帮她歇一歇，可她从不喜欢晚饭后打盹。

26.3.en: She loves a [[quiet:quiet]] room at noon, for loud noise [[can:can]] [[cripple:cripple]] her daytime rest.
26.3.zh: 她喜欢中午有个安静的房间，因为吵闹的声响会毁掉她白天的休息。

26.4.en: She once feared she would be [[lame:lame]] forever, until she saw how one tall tree [[can:can]] [[dwarf:dwarf]] the small [[grass:grass]] at its foot.
26.4.zh: 她曾怕自己一辈子都瘸着好不了，后来看到一棵高树怎样把脚边的小草衬得矮小，心里才释然。

26.5.en: Mum recalls the days of her [[pregnancy:pregnancy]] long ago, when Dad made a silly joke about a thin [[condom:condom]] at a health talk.
26.5.zh: 妈妈回忆起多年前怀孕的日子，那时爸爸在健康讲座上还拿一只薄薄的避孕套开了句傻玩笑。

27.0.en: The doctor sends her blood for a careful [[clone:clone]] test of her cells, finds no [[error:error]], and notes each small [[symptom:symptom]] with care.
27.0.zh: 医生把她的血样送去，仔细做细胞层面的检测，没发现差错，还认真记下每一个小症状。

27.1.en: No serious [[disease:disease]] shows on the scans, yet a [[mild:mild]] [[illness:illness]] makes her cough at [[night:night]].
27.1.zh: 扫描没查出严重的疾病，只是一场轻微的小病让她夜里咳嗽。

27.2.en: She never lets out a [[moan:moan]], though a [[mild:mild]] [[infection:infection]] gives her cold sweats.
27.2.zh: 她从不呻吟一声，尽管轻微的感染让她直冒冷汗。

27.3.en: Smoking is a clear [[detriment:detriment]] to good health, and a bad fall [[can:can]] leave a [[broken:broken]] arm.
27.3.zh: 吸烟明显有损健康，重重摔一跤还可能摔断胳膊。

27.4.en: Too much sugar [[can:can]] [[disable:disable]] a strong person, leaving her feeling like an [[invalid:invalid]] for weeks.
27.4.zh: 糖吃太多也能拖垮一个壮实的人，让她一连几个星期都像病人一样提不起劲。

27.5.en: As a calm [[patient:patient]], she tells the [[nurse:nurse]] about her sleep [[dysfunction:dysfunction]] in detail.
27.5.zh: 作为一位沉静的病人，她向护士细细讲了自己的睡眠障碍。

28.0.en: No sign of [[diabetes:diabetes]] shows up today, and no sign of [[obesity:obesity]] worries the [[nurse:nurse]] either.
28.0.zh: 今天没有查出糖尿病的迹象，也没有让护士担心的肥胖迹象。

28.1.en: She is not [[overweight:overweight]] at all, though [[mild:mild]] [[hypertension:hypertension]] calls for daily checks.
28.1.zh: 她一点也不超重，只是轻微的高血压需要每天检查。

28.2.en: Fright [[can:can]] [[paralyse:paralyse]] an old body, leaving it shaking and [[dizzy:dizzy]] for hours.
28.2.zh: 惊吓能让老人的身体一下子僵住，抖上好几个小时，头晕眼花。

28.3.en: Worry is strange but not [[insane:insane]], yet long [[insomnia:insomnia]] [[can:can]] [[steal:steal]] her [[night:night]] rest away.
28.3.zh: 忧愁虽然缠人，却算不上疯癫；可长期的失眠会偷走她夜里的安睡。

28.4.en: She has no food [[allergy:allergy]], and the scan shows no sign of [[heart attack:heart attack]] [[risk:risk]] now.
28.4.zh: 她没有食物过敏，扫描也显示目前没有心脏病发作的风险。

28.5.en: No [[trace:trace]] of [[cancer:cancer]] shows up in her tests, though [[mild:mild]] [[arthritis:arthritis]] stiffens her hands a little.
28.5.zh: 各项检查里都没查出癌的踪迹，只是轻微的关节炎让她的手指有点发僵。

29.0.en: The doctor [[saw:saw]] no sign of [[stroke:stroke]] at all, and even the small [[pimple:pimple]] on her nose has faded.
29.0.zh: 医生完全没看出中风的迹象，连她鼻子上那颗小粉刺也消了。

29.1.en: No [[plague:plague]] walks our streets today, and only a [[mild:mild]] [[flu:flu]] visits each winter term.
29.1.zh: 如今没有瘟疫在我们街上出没，每年来串门的只是一场轻微的流感。

29.2.en: Her [[mild:mild]] [[fever:fever]] fell last [[night:night]], and her dull [[headache:headache]] left with the morning tea.
29.2.zh: 她昨晚的低烧退了，闷闷的头痛也随早晨那杯茶一起散了。

29.3.en: Her foot did not [[swell:swell]] any more, and dry food never makes her [[choke:choke]] at meals.
29.3.zh: 她的脚没有再肿起来，干一点的东西也从没让她在饭桌上噎着。

29.4.en: A [[slip:slip]] [[can:can]] [[injure:injure]] an old person who walks slowly, so we [[guard:guard]] her from any [[injury:injury]] on rainy days.
29.4.zh: 脚下一滑就可能伤到走路慢的老人，所以下雨天我们护着她，不让她受一点伤。

29.5.en: If she falls she may [[hurt:hurt]] herself, but her skin does not [[bleed:bleed]] often now.
29.5.zh: 她要是摔了可能会伤到自己，好在她的皮肤如今不常流血了。

30.0.en: A dark [[bruise:bruise]] faded on her arm, leaving only a thin white [[scar:scar]].
30.0.zh: 她手臂上的黑瘀青淡了下去，只留下一道细细的白疤。

30.1.en: We clean each small [[wound:wound]] softly, for we worry about any deep [[trauma:trauma]] inside her.
30.1.zh: 我们轻轻清洗每一处小伤口，生怕她身体里面还藏着内伤。

30.2.en: No hard [[lump:lump]] has grown on her arm, and she feels no sharp [[pain:pain]] during the walk.
30.2.zh: 她手臂上没有长硬块，散步时也没有感到刺痛。

30.3.en: We never speak of [[death:death]] at home, for every [[mortal:mortal]] life feels precious to us.
30.3.zh: 我们在家从不谈论死亡，因为每一条终有一死的生命都让我们觉得珍贵。

30.4.en: We do not [[dread:dread]] a sad [[demise:demise]], nor do we wait each day for dismal [[doom:doom]].
30.4.zh: 我们不惧怕一场悲伤的离世，也不天天等着阴郁的厄运降临。

30.5.en: No [[fatal:fatal]] [[crash:crash]] has touched our street, and no [[lethal:lethal]] smoke has entered our home.
30.5.zh: 致命的车祸从没光顾过我们这条街，致命的浓烟也从没进过我们的家门。

31.0.en: The doctor keeps a [[corpus:corpus]] of health [[record:records]], and warns his tired colleagues against [[overwork:overwork]].
31.0.zh: 医生保存着一份份健康记录，还提醒身边劳累的同事切莫过度操劳。

31.1.en: Long stairs make her legs [[tire:tire]], and smoky buses [[exhaust:exhaust]] her every morning.
31.1.zh: 长长的楼梯让她双腿发酸，冒烟的公交车每天一早把她累得够呛。

31.2.en: [[mild:Mild]] [[fatigue:fatigue]] comes after lunch, but she never [[faint:faints]] on our walks.
31.2.zh: 午饭后会来一阵轻微的疲乏，可她散步时从来没有昏倒过。

31.3.en: Her steps felt [[feeble:feeble]] yesterday, for the long wait left her [[weary:weary]] and pale.
31.3.zh: 昨天她的脚步很虚弱，久久的等待让她又疲倦又苍白。

31.4.en: Hunger [[can:can]] [[weaken:weaken]] her arms fast, and cold seats feel [[uncomfortable:uncomfortable]] against her spine.
31.4.zh: 饥饿很快让她手臂发软，冰冷的座椅抵着脊背也很不舒服。

31.5.en: She had never fallen [[unconscious:unconscious]] before, though a [[chronic:chronic]] cough stayed for months.
31.5.zh: 她以前从来没有昏过去，只是那慢性咳嗽拖了好几个月。

32.0.en: No [[acute:acute]] cough troubles her now, only a light [[sore:sore]] spot on her arm after the rain.
32.0.zh: 如今没有急性咳嗽来烦她，雨后只是手臂上有一小块地方微微作痛。

32.1.en: So we hide our [[sorrow:sorrow]] behind smiles, and share less of our [[suffering:suffering]] with Grandma each day.
32.1.zh: 于是我们把悲伤藏进笑容里，每天少向奶奶诉说自己的苦处。

32.2.en: We hear no sad [[lament:lament]] at home now — only music for morning [[therapy:therapy]].
32.2.zh: 家里如今听不到伤心的哀叹，只有当作晨间治疗的音乐声。

32.3.en: Good [[health care:health care]] starts at home, with clean [[sanitary:sanitary]] habits every day.
32.3.zh: 好的健康护理从家里开始，每天都保持干净卫生的习惯。

32.4.en: Warm soup is [[curative:curative]] late at [[night:night]], and daily [[hygiene:hygiene]] keeps colds away.
32.4.zh: 深夜一碗热汤也有疗效，天天讲卫生，感冒就不容易找上门。

32.5.en: Our kind [[physician:physician]] calls every week, and a young [[surgeon:surgeon]] checks her scans too.
32.5.zh: 我们和善的内科医生每周都来电话，年轻的外科医生也会看她的片子。

33.0.en: She needs no big [[operation:operation]] now, for rest and good food will [[cure:cure]] her slowly.
33.0.zh: 她现在不需要大手术，好好休息、好好吃饭，身体会慢慢痊愈。

33.1.en: Time will [[heal:heal]] her gently, and the short [[prescription:prescription]] lists two [[mild:mild]] teas.
33.1.zh: 时间会温柔地治好她，短短的处方上只列着两种温和的茶饮。

33.2.en: She needs no skin [[transplant:transplant]] at all, nor any [[injection:injection]] this year.
33.2.zh: 她完全不需要皮肤移植，今年也不用打任何针。

33.3.en: As a wise [[precaution:precaution]], the clinic will [[vaccinate:vaccinate]] the whole family in [[spring:spring]].
33.3.zh: 作为一种明智的预防，诊所开春会给全家接种疫苗。

33.4.en: We never need to [[quarantine:quarantine]] Grandma, nor [[segregate:segregate]] her meals from ours.
33.4.zh: 我们从不需要隔离奶奶，也不把她的饭菜和我们的分开。

33.5.en: We never [[isolate:isolate]] her in her room, for the corner [[pharmacy:pharmacy]] brings her teas every day.
33.5.zh: 我们从不把她一个人关在房里，街角的药房每天都给她送茶来。

34.0.en: Her daily [[medicine:medicine]] tastes sweet, and honey tea is her evening [[remedy:remedy]] too.
34.0.zh: 她每天吃的药带着甜味，蜂蜜茶也是她晚间的良方。

34.1.en: No strong [[drug:drug]] sits on her [[shelf:shelf]] now — only one small [[pill:pill]] beside warm water.
34.1.zh: 她的架子上如今没有烈性药，只有一小粒药片放在温水旁边。

34.2.en: The doctor refused every [[antibiotic:antibiotic]] for her colds, and once chose soft [[acupuncture:acupuncture]] instead.
34.2.zh: 她感冒时，医生拒绝使用任何抗生素，倒有一次选了轻柔的针灸来代替。

34.3.en: No [[penicillin:penicillin]] shot was needed today, and no strong [[morphine:morphine]] dulled her smile.
34.3.zh: 今天不需要打青霉素针，也没有烈性吗啡让她笑容黯淡。

34.4.en: Each small [[dose:dose]] follows the clock closely, guiding her slow [[recovery:recovery]] day by day.
34.4.zh: 每一小剂药都严格按着钟点服下，陪她一天天慢慢康复。

34.5.en: Morning walks [[refresh:refresh]] her face brightly, bringing sweet [[relief:relief]] to us all.
34.5.zh: 晨走让她脸上重新有了光彩，也给我们大家带来甜甜的宽慰。

35.0.en: [[gentle:Gentle]] songs [[relieve:relieve]] her worry at [[dusk:dusk]], and warm baths [[alleviate:alleviate]] the ache in her legs.
35.0.zh: 黄昏时分，轻柔的歌减轻她的忧愁，暖暖的浴缓解她腿上的酸痛。

35.1.en: Warm tea [[can:can]] [[ease:ease]] her cough at [[night:night]], helping her body [[relax:relax]] under the soft light.
35.1.zh: 热茶夜里能缓解她的咳嗽，帮她的身体在柔光下放松下来。

35.2.en: Her sleep is [[normal:normal]] again, and smiles are [[common:common]] [[round:round]] our dinner table.
35.2.zh: 她的睡眠又正常了，笑容在我们家的晚餐桌上随处可见。

35.3.en: Our [[usual:usual]] walk starts after breakfast, and Grandma feels bright and [[optimistic:optimistic]] every time.
35.3.zh: 我们照例早饭后出门散步，奶奶每次都觉得心里亮堂、满怀乐观。

35.4.en: No one feels [[pessimistic:pessimistic]] now, for each small win brings [[positive:positive]] cheer back home.
35.4.zh: 如今没人再悲观，每一个小小的胜利都给家里带回积极的欢乐。

paraZh.24: 查肺看腿脚，暖毯相伴，散步成良方。
paraZh.25: 脉搏平稳晨走护免疫，睡眠视力需留意。
paraZh.26: 查听牙问睡眠，高树小草宽了奶奶的心。
paraZh.27: 验血记症状无大恙，奶奶坦然述病情。
paraZh.28: 慢病筛查皆无碍，唯防惊吓与失眠。
paraZh.29: 中风流感皆远离，防滑防噎护周全。
paraZh.30: 伤痕渐愈心无惧，全家珍惜平静生活。
paraZh.31: 爬楼坐车易疲乏，幸无大碍未昏倒。
paraZh.32: 藏悲报喜守卫生，音乐热汤皆是疗愈。
paraZh.33: 无需手术只需调养，春日全家打疫苗。
paraZh.34: 甜药蜜茶慢慢调理，晨走带来宽慰。
paraZh.35: 歌浴茶香助安眠，笑容重回晚餐桌。
